description.value: Pyrgos Taverna is a family-owned Greek restaurant in Maple Ridge that has been serving traditional Greek home cooking for over 25 years under the care of George and his family. The menu is made entirely in-house using the traditions of Greece, featuring classics like spanakopita, dolmades, saganaki, and charbroiled ribs. Cyclists riding the Lougheed Highway corridor will find a welcoming sit-down meal with both dine-in and takeout options.

address.value: 22570 Lougheed Hwy., Maple Ridge, BC V2X 2V1
